# Fishing spot: category_633

In-game name: Fishing spot. 5 sites with 5 placed in all; 0 of the sites in F2P; 0 a walk from the Lumbridge spawn reaches with no requirement (Requires -; a quest that locks a site's features is a requirement), 2 it does not reach (unreached).

The options of each spot config placed in the world (its npc or loc config).

What each option catches, from the spot's script (Source) and each fish's fishing struct (skill_fishing/configs/fishing.struct): Base XP is its productexp / 10 (productexp is in tenths of XP), Low and High its success_low and success_high.

| Option | Level | Tool | Bait | Catch | Base XP | Low | High | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fish | - | Karambwan vessel | - | can't read this catch: it rolls inline with stat_random(fishing, ...), not ~fish_roll | - | - | - | skill_fishing/scripts/fishing_spots/tbwt.rs2:99 |

Low and high are the stat_random bounds: an attempt succeeds with chance (low + 1)/256 at Fishing level 1, rising evenly to (high + 1)/256 at 99 (server/engine/src/engine/script/handlers/PlayerOps.ts).

The server multiplies the base XP by its xpRate (25 on the local server, learnings/local-server.md).

## Movement

A spot teleports to a random tile of its movement enum that holds no other spot every 280 + random(250) ticks (skill_fishing/scripts/fishing_movement.rs2), so the spots of a shore roam over all of its tiles and a plan must stay within reach of every one. The cover is a centre and a Chebyshev radius that include every tile with 3 tiles of margin; copy it as the plan's `area`.
